title: Media Converter
description: Compress videos, convert formats and extract audio, all on this computer. Files are never uploaded.

unsupported.title: Not available on this platform
unsupported.body: The media converter currently runs on Windows only.

upload.title: Add audio and video files
upload.hint: Drop video or audio files anywhere on the page, or choose them; several at once is fine
upload.unavailable: Files cannot be added right now: {{reason}}. {{advice}}
upload.hint_more: Drop or choose more files, up to 100 at a time
upload.drop_label: Release to add to the Media Converter

settings.title: Conversion settings

codec_compatibility.av1: Smallest files; the built-in players of iPhones before the iPhone 15 Pro and Macs before M3 cannot play them
codec_compatibility.hevc: Plays on every Apple device; the Windows Photos app needs the HEVC extension
codec_compatibility.h264: Plays on almost every device and app; larger files

settings.weak_encoder: Only the weaker {{encoder}} can encode {{codec}} here, so files come out larger.
settings.container_hint: Auto: MKV for image subtitles, styled subtitles or attachments, MP4 otherwise.
settings.gpu_hint: Faster, but files are about twice as large
settings.gpu_disabled_codec: Only "Smallest size (AV1)" lets you choose the graphics card. HEVC and H.264 use the graphics card automatically when there is one.
settings.gpu_disabled_hardware: No AV1 graphics encoder works on this computer. HEVC and H.264 use the graphics card automatically when there is one.
settings.gpu_disabled_detecting: The encoders are still being detected; whether the graphics card can encode AV1 is known afterwards. HEVC and H.264 use the graphics card automatically when there is one.
settings.discard_hint: Nothing is saved when compression does not make the file clearly smaller
settings.remux_label: Change only the container when possible
settings.remux_hint: Audio and video that can be copied are not re-encoded: fast and lossless
settings.all_tracks_hint: One file per audio track; off extracts the default track only
settings.output_source_hint: Output files are saved in the folder of each source file
settings.output_directory_missing: The output folder chosen before is no longer available; files are saved next to their sources again
settings.overwrite_warning: The old file of that name goes to the Recycle Bin; a source file is never overwritten
settings.low_usage_hint: Encodes more slowly but keeps games and other apps running smoothly

engine.detecting_detail: Short test encodes check the graphics card and CPU encoders of this computer. You can add files now; conversions start once this is done.
engine.cpu_only_detail: No graphics encoder works on this computer, so the CPU does all encoding.
engine.degraded: Paused after an error in this session: {{encoders}}. Detecting again brings them back.
engine.driver_update_version: The {{family}} graphics driver is too old: version {{version}} or newer is needed. Update the graphics driver, then click "Detect again".
engine.driver_update: The {{family}} graphics driver is too old. Update the graphics driver, then click "Detect again".

advice.platform_unsupported: The media converter works on Windows only for now.
advice.reinstall: The bundled FFmpeg is missing or was changed. Reinstall FusionKit and try again.
advice.spawn_failed: FFmpeg cannot start; security software may be blocking it. Check it, then click "Detect again".
advice.driver: Update the graphics driver, then click "Detect again".

engine.redetect_busy: A graphics card encode is running; detect again when it ends

request_errors.busy: Something else is in progress; try again in a moment
request_errors.platform_unsupported: The media converter is not supported on this platform
request_errors.invalid_request: The request was not accepted; reload the page and try again
request_errors.unknown: That did not work; please try again

rejected.temporary_copy_unresolved: “{{name}}” is a temporary copy whose original cannot be found. Extract it first, or add it with Choose files.
rejected.file_unavailable: “{{name}}” cannot be read: its place on disk is unknown. Add it with Choose files.

rejected_many.not_a_regular_file: {{count}} items are not regular files and were not added ({{names}}). Choose the actual audio or video files.

not_applicable.audio_compress: This is an audio file; Compress handles videos
not_applicable.audio_extract: This is already an audio file; there is nothing to extract
not_applicable.no_video: It has no picture, so it cannot become a video format
not_applicable.no_audio: This video has no audio track

queue.no_encoder_none: No other output codec can either

queue.disk_space: Not enough disk space: {{required}} needed, {{available}} free
queue.start_none: No files are waiting to start
queue.cancel_all_body: {{count}} queued or running files will be cancelled. Unfinished temporary files are deleted; outputs already saved are kept.
queue.cancel_all_body_one: 1 queued or running file will be cancelled. Unfinished temporary files are deleted; outputs already saved are kept.

queue.reveal_missing: “{{name}}” is no longer where it was saved
queue.background: Conversions continue in the background; come back to this page to see their progress

result.interrupted: It did not finish before the app closed; you can retry
result.input_changed: The file changed after it was added, so it did not start; a retry analyzes it again

failure_advice.session_limit: The graphics card is already running as many encodes as it can, for example for a game or a screen recorder. Try again later.
failure_advice.params_rejected: The encoder on this computer refused the settings it was given. Try again; if it fails again, choose another output codec.
failure_advice.encoder_stalled: FFmpeg made no progress for a long time and was stopped. Try again; if it fails again, choose another output codec.
failure_advice.output_open_failed: FFmpeg could not create the output file in the target folder: the folder may not be writable, or security software blocked it. Check it and try again, or choose another output folder.
failure_advice.disk_full: The target disk filled up while writing; the unfinished file was deleted. Free up space and try again.
failure_advice.disk_space_low: The check before the start found too little free space on the target disk for the output. Free up space, or choose another output folder, and try again.
failure_advice.input_missing: The source file was moved, renamed or deleted. Put it back and try again, or add it again.
failure_advice.encode_failed: FFmpeg failed without a more specific reason. The end of the log may tell more; try again, and if it fails again, choose another output codec or format.
failure_advice.output_cap_exceeded: The output became far larger than expected and was stopped before it could fill the disk; the unfinished file was deleted. Choose another output codec or format and try again.
failure_advice.file_too_large_for_volume: The target disk uses FAT32, which cannot hold files over 4 GB. Save the output to an NTFS or exFAT disk.
failure_advice.output_is_input: The output would have the same name and place as a source file. Choose another output folder and try again.
failure_advice.output_dir_unwritable: The target folder does not exist or cannot be written to. Choose another output folder and try again.
failure_advice.output_path_too_long: The output's full path is longer than Windows allows. Choose an output folder closer to the top of the disk.
failure_advice.overwrite_trash_failed: The old file of that name could not be moved to the Recycle Bin, so it was not replaced. Switch to “Number it” and try again.
failure_advice.output_publish_failed: The conversion finished, but the result could not be saved under its final name; the unfinished file was deleted. Check the target folder and try again.
failure_advice.confirmation_required: This file needs a confirmation first (for example lossy audio to a lossless format). Start it again and confirm in the dialog.
failure_advice.no_encoder_available: No encoder on this computer can handle this picture. Choose another output codec and start again.
failure_advice.busy: The file is still being analyzed or is in use by another action. Try again in a moment.
failure_advice.not_applicable: Analyzed again, the file no longer fits the task it was started with. Switch the task and start again.
failure_advice.unknown: The conversion did not finish, for an unknown reason. Try again; if it fails again, copy the error below to report it.

confirm.title: Confirm before starting
confirm.description: {{count}} files need your confirmation ({{total}} in this start). Skip any you like; the others start together.
confirm.description_one: 1 file needs your confirmation ({{total}} in this start). Skip it if you like; the others start together.
confirm.mkv_note: “Change to MKV” sets the output format to MKV for every file in this start.
confirm.resolved: Changed to MKV; nothing is lost
confirm.lossless: Lossy audio to a lossless format: the file gets larger, the sound does not get better
confirm.replace: Moves the old files of the same name to the Recycle Bin: {{names}}
confirm.replace_one: Moves the old file of the same name to the Recycle Bin: {{names}}
confirm.skipped: Skipped this time; it will not start
